source: robinhood-trading MCP tool definitions (schemas only — no tokens, account data, or tool results)

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__add_option_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add option contracts to the user's options watchlist. Works for both equity options (AAPL, NVDA) and index options (SPX, NDX, RUT). Source option_ids from get_option_instruments. Confirm with the user before calling — this is a real write.

option_ids.description: Option contract UUIDs to add. Each becomes a single-leg position on the user's options watchlist. Source from get_option_instruments.

position_type.description: "long" (default) or "short". Applies to every option_id in this call. For mixed long/short adds, issue two calls.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add items to a watchlist. Exactly one of symbols (stocks/ETFs), currency_pair_ids (crypto), or index_ids (market indexes like SPX, NDX) is required — mutually exclusive. For options use add_option_to_watchlist (separate dedicated watchlist). Futures still require the Robinhood app. Already-present items are no-ops. Confirm with the user before calling.

list_id.description: UUID of the watchlist to add items to.

symbols.description: Stock symbols to add (e.g. ['AAPL', 'NVDA']). US stocks and ETFs only. Mutually exclusive with currency_pair_ids and index_ids.

currency_pair_ids.description: Currency-pair UUIDs to add. Mutually exclusive with symbols and index_ids.

index_ids.description: Market-index UUIDs to add (the id field from get_indexes; SPX, NDX, DJI, etc.). Mutually exclusive with symbols and currency_pair_ids.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__cancel_equity_order
tools.description: Cancel an open equity order by order_id. Always confirm with the user before calling. Resolve order_id via get_equity_orders if the user refers to it by symbol or description; pass the same account_number. Requires an agentic_allowed=true account; non-agentic accounts are rejected — do not call. Cancellation may be rejected if the order has already filled, was already cancelled, or is otherwise ineligible.

account_number.description: Brokerage account that owns the order. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

order_id.description: Order UUID from get_equity_orders. Must live in account_number.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__cancel_option_order
tools.description: Cancel an open option order by account_number + order_id. Always confirm with the user before calling. Resolve order_id via get_option_orders if the user refers to it by description; pass the same account_number you used there. Requires an agentic_allowed=true account; non-agentic accounts are rejected. Cancellation may be rejected if the order has already filled, was already cancelled, or is otherwise ineligible.

account_number.description: Brokerage account that owns the order. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

order_id.description: Order UUID from get_option_orders. Must live in account_number.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__create_scan
tools.description: Create a new saved scanner (screener) on the user's account, optionally applying a preset and custom filters in a single call. Returns the new scan's id, title, applied filters, and the initial live market results.

preset.description: Starting preset for the new scan. One of: INITIAL (no preset; only valid if filters are provided), DAILY_GAINERS, DAILY_LOSERS, HIGH_OPTIONS_VOLUME_IV, UPCOMING_EARNINGS. Defaults to DAILY_GAINERS when no filters are provided, INITIAL when filters are provided.

filters.description: Custom filters to apply after the preset. Each filter has filter_type (FILTER_TYPE_... enum), predicate (>, <, =, BETWEEN, etc.), values, optional interval (e.g. 1d), and optional length (e.g. 14 for RSI). Call get_scanner_filter_specs first for valid filter_type / predicate combinations.

values.description: Threshold values. Single-element for unary predicates, two-element for BETWEEN, multi-element for IN_LIST/ANY_OF.

length.description: Lookback length for filters that need one (e.g. RSI period of 14).

plot.description: Plot / price-field input for filters that have one (e.g. "open" or "close" for % Change).

title.description: Optional custom title for the saved scan.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__create_watchlist
tools.description: Create a new custom watchlist for the user. Confirm the name with the user before calling — this is a real write. Do not use this to follow a Robinhood-curated list (use follow_watchlist).

display_name.description: Name for the new watchlist (e.g. 'Tech Stocks'). Must be unique among the user's watchlists.

display_description.description: Short description shown under the name.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji shown next to the name (one character).

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__follow_watchlist
tools.description: Follow a Robinhood-curated list so it appears in the user's watchlists. Confirm with the user before calling. Use only for curated lists; the user already owns their custom lists.

list_id.description: UUID of the Robinhood-curated list to follow. Obtain from get_popular_watchlists.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_accounts
tools.description: List the user's brokerage accounts. Use this to look up account_number values needed by other tools. If the user has multiple accounts and hasn't specified which one, present the list and ask them to choose. Does NOT return reliable buying power — route buying-power questions through get_portfolio.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: List earnings reports scheduled across the market over a date window (up to 31 days), optionally limited to high-market-cap names. Returns one entry per report event — estimated/actual EPS, report date and timing (am/pm), and company-verification status. Use this for market-wide discovery ("what large-caps report this week?"). For a specific known ticker, use get_earnings_results instead. Read-only.

start_date.description: Window anchor, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (US/Eastern) when omitted.

days.description: Window length in days, measured from start_date. Defaults to 7. Positive = forward window; negative = look-back window. Must be a non-zero value between -31 and 31.

filter.description: Optional result filter. Set to 'high_market_cap' to limit the calendar to high-market-cap names (market cap over $1B). Omit for all names.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_earnings_results
tools.description: Get recent and upcoming earnings for ONE equity symbol — estimated/actual EPS, report date and timing (am/pm), and company-verification status. Returns the trailing up to 8 quarters. Use this for earnings-timing questions, EPS surprise analysis, and screening for upcoming earnings risk on a specific stock. For market-wide earnings calendar queries across many symbols, use get_earnings_calendar. Read-only.

symbol.description: Stock symbol to look up (one symbol per call). Exact-ticker match only. Returns the trailing up to 8 quarters of earnings for the symbol.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_fundamentals
tools.description: Get today's fundamentals for one or more stock symbols — valuation ratios (PE, P/B), capitalization (market cap, shares outstanding, float), today's session OHLCV, trailing volume averages, 52-week range, dividend schedule, and company profile. For real-time quotes use get_equity_quotes; for time-series price history use get_equity_historicals.

symbols.description: One or more stock symbols (max 10 per call). Exact-ticker match only.

bounds.description: Trading session the day-level fields are drawn from. One of 'regular', 'trading', 'extended', '24_5'. Defaults to 'regular' when omitted.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_historicals
tools.description: Get OHLCV bars for one or more equity symbols across an explicit time range. Use this for charting, "recent activity" questions, and backtesting. The server auto-selects an interval when one is not provided.

symbols.description: One or more stock symbols (uppercase). Up to 10 per call.

start_time.description: Start of the range (RFC3339 UTC, e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Required.

end_time.description: End of the range (RFC3339 UTC). Optional — defaults to the current time.

interval.description: Bar interval. Optional — when omitted, the server picks an interval that targets ~2,500 bars. Intraday: 15second, 30second, minute, 5minute, 10minute, 30minute, hour, 4hour. Interday: day, week, month, 3month, 6month, year, 5year, 10year, 20year, 50year.

adjustment_type.description: Corporate-action adjustment: 'none' (raw prices), 'split' (default), or 'all' (split + dividend; intraday only).

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_orders
tools.description: Fetch equity orders for an account — list mode (newest first; open and closed, including fills, cancellations, rejections) or single-order mode by passing order_id. When the user asks for "orders" without specifying equity or options, call both get_equity_orders and get_option_orders in parallel.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

order_id.description: Filter to a single order by UUID.

state.description: Filter by single state: new, queued, confirmed, unconfirmed, partially_filled, filled, cancelled, rejected, failed, voided.

created_at_gte.description: Lower bound (inclusive). ISO 8601 UTC or YYYY-MM-DD.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_positions
tools.description: List open equity positions for a specific brokerage account. Returns symbol, quantity, average cost, and per-position hold breakdowns.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_price_book
tools.description: Get a real-time bid/ask order book (Level 2) snapshot for one or more equity symbols (max 4), showing the ladder of price levels and resting share size on each side. Use to read supply/demand depth before entering or exiting a position.

symbols.description: One or more stock symbols, max 4 per call.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time stock quotes and the official last-completed-session close for one or more symbols.

symbols.description: One or more stock symbols. Above 20 symbols, quotes still return but closes is omitted with closes_error set.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_tax_lots
tools.description: List the open tax lots for one equity holding in an account — each lot is a separate acquisition with its own quantity, cost basis, acquisition date, and long/short-term status. Requires a symbol (tax lots are tracked per instrument). Use it for cost-basis, holding-period, or which-lots-would-sell questions.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the holding whose tax lots you want. One symbol per call.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_technical_indicators
tools.description: Compute a technical indicator (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, moving averages, ATR, VWAP, and more) over one equity symbol's OHLCV bars across a time range. For the raw OHLCV bars themselves, use get_equity_historicals.

symbol.description: Stock symbol (uppercase). Exactly one symbol per call.

type.description: Indicator to compute. One of: ema, sma, rsi, momentum, roc, cci, williams_r, atr, mfi, adx, donchian_channels, bollinger_bands, macd, keltner_channels, supertrend, vwap, obv, pivot_points.

interval.description: Required bar interval. Intraday: 15second, 30second, minute, 5minute, 10minute, 30minute, hour, 4hour. Interday: day, week, month, 3month, 6month, year, 5year, 10year, 20year, 50year.

start_time.description: Start of the range (RFC3339 UTC, e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Required.

end_time.description: End of the range (RFC3339 UTC). Optional — defaults to the current time.

period.description: Lookback period in bars. Applies to ema, sma, rsi, momentum, roc, cci, williams_r, atr, mfi, adx, donchian_channels, bollinger_bands, keltner_channels, supertrend.

num_std.description: Number of standard deviations for the bands. bollinger_bands only (default 2).

multiplier.description: Band/offset multiplier. keltner_channels (default 2) and supertrend (default 3) only.

method.description: Calculation method. pivot_points only; currently only 'classic'.

output.description: How much of the series to return: 'series' (default, full range), 'latest' (most recent bar only), or 'last:N' (most recent N bars).

bounds.description: Session bounds. One of 'regular' (RTH, default) or 'extended'.

adjustment_type.description: Corporate-action adjustment: 'none' (raw prices), 'split' (default), or 'all' (split + dividend; requires a day-or-coarser interval).

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_equity_tradability
tools.description: Check tradability for up to 10 equity symbols on a given account: per-session eligibility and fractional. Call before placing an order to surface restrictions. Exact-ticker match only.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_financials
tools.description: Get a company's reported financial metrics over time — revenue, gross profit, net income, and net margin — by fiscal period (annual or quarterly), for one or more symbols. Use this for fundamental analysis like revenue-growth and margin-trend tracking, profitability screens, and period-over-period comparisons. Read-only.

symbols.description: One or more stock symbols (max 20 per call). Exact-ticker match only.

period.description: Reporting period: 'quarterly' or 'annual'. Defaults to 'quarterly' when omitted.

limit.description: Number of most-recent periods to return per symbol. Defaults to 4; values above 40 are capped to 40.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_index_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time values for one or more market indexes by instrument ID. Returns current index level, state, and timestamps.

instrument_ids.description: One or more index instrument IDs (UUIDs) to fetch current values for. Obtain IDs from the get_indexes tool.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_indexes
tools.description: Get index data for market indexes by symbol. Optionally pass a comma-separated list of symbols (e.g. 'SPX,NDX,DJI') to filter results. Omit symbols to return all available indexes.

symbols.description: Comma-separated list of index symbols to look up (e.g. 'SPX,NDX'). Omit to return all available indexes.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_chains
tools.description: List option chains for one or more underlyings. A chain describes the full set of expiration dates and contracts for a given underlying. One of underlying_symbol or ids is required.

underlying_symbol.description: Ticker filter; covers equity and index underlyings (e.g. 'AAPL', 'SPX').

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_instruments
tools.description: List option contracts. One of chain_symbol, chain_id, or ids is required; narrow further with expiration_dates, strike_price, type, state. When looking up contracts for a specific expiration, call this in parallel for every chain whose expiration_dates includes the date.

tradability.description: 'tradable' or 'untradable' (untradable is rejected at the tool layer).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_level_upgrade_info
tools.description: Get the upgrade URL to apply for options access on an account. Call when option_level is null. option_level_2 enables long calls/puts, covered calls, and cash-secured puts; option_level_3 adds spreads and complex strategies, though multi-leg orders are not yet supported here.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number to generate the upgrade URL for. Obtain from get_accounts.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_orders
tools.description: Fetch options orders for an account — list mode (newest first; open and closed, including fills, cancellations, and rejections) or single-order mode by passing order_id. When the user asks for "orders" without specifying equity or options, call both get_option_orders and get_equity_orders in parallel.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

order_id.description: Filter to a single order by UUID.

state.description: Filter by single state: queued, confirmed, partially_filled, filled, rejected, cancelled, failed, voided, pending_cancelled.

chain_ids.description: Comma-separated chain UUIDs (from get_option_chains) to filter by underlying.

created_at_gte.description: Lower bound (inclusive). ISO 8601 UTC or YYYY-MM-DD.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_positions
tools.description: List options positions for an account. Returns open and closed (zero-quantity) positions. Pass nonzero=true for "what options do I have" / "show me my positions" — the common case.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts.

nonzero.description: True to return only currently-open positions; omit/false to include closed ones.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time quotes for one or more option contracts by instrument UUID, plus the official prior-session close for each.

instrument_ids.description: Option instrument UUIDs. Above 20, quotes still return but closes is omitted with closes_error set.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_option_watchlist
tools.description: List the single-leg option contracts on the user's options watchlist. Use this instead of get_watchlist_items for the options watchlist. Works for both equity options (AAPL, NVDA) and index options (SPX, NDX, RUT). Multi-leg strategies not shown — direct the user to the Robinhood app to view those.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_pnl_trade_history
tools.description: Get a customer's per-trade realized profit & loss — a chronological, paginated list of closed/realizing trades (equities, options, crypto, prediction markets) with symbol, side, quantity, price, and realized gain/loss. Read-only. Use get_realized_pnl for aggregate/bucketed totals.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number (the rhs_account_number from get_accounts). Obtain it from get_accounts.

span.description: Preset window: week (default), month, 3month, ytd, or all.

symbol.description: Optional single stock symbol filter. Omit for all symbols; one symbol per call.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_popular_watchlists
tools.description: Discover Robinhood-curated lists the user can follow (e.g. '100 Most Popular', 'Daily Movers'). Use to find a list_id, then pass it to follow_watchlist.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_portfolio
tools.description: Get the account's portfolio market value breakdown by asset type and buying power. Use for "how much is my account worth?", "what's my portfolio breakdown?", "how much do I have in options?", and "how much can I spend / afford?" questions.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Obtain from get_accounts.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_realized_pnl
tools.description: Get a customer's realized profit & loss for an account over a time window — per-bucket realized gain ($ and %) and the number of closing trades, plus window totals. Read-only. Aggregate, bucketed numbers only (not individual trades). Use for post-trade analysis.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number (the rhs_account_number from get_accounts). Obtain it from get_accounts.

span.description: Preset window: day, week, month, 3month, year, or all. Defaults to 3month. Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: Custom window start, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use with end_date instead of span.

end_date.description: Custom window end, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use with start_date instead of span.

asset_classes.description: Filter to one or more of equity, option, crypto. Omit for all asset classes.

display_currency.description: Currency for returned amounts. Currently USD only; defaults to USD.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for bucket day-boundaries (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to account timezone (US Eastern).

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_scanner_filter_specs
tools.description: List every valid scanner filter type and how to use it. Call this before constructing filters for create_scan or update_scan_filters — do not guess filter_type names. This tool takes no parameters.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_scans
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved scanners (also called screeners). Returns one entry per scan with its id, title, active filters, column count, sort order, and a flag indicating whether the scan is managed by Cortex. Cortex-managed scans are read-only via MCP. This tool takes no parameters.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_watchlist_items
tools.description: List the items in a watchlist. Items may be stocks/ETFs, crypto pairs, futures, indexes — distinguished by object_type. For the options watchlist, use get_option_watchlist instead. Does not return live prices.

list_id.description: UUID of the watchlist whose items to fetch. Obtain from get_watchlists or get_popular_watchlists.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__get_watchlists
tools.description: List the user's watchlists, including both user-created custom lists and Robinhood-curated lists the user follows. Use to look up list_id values for other watchlist tools.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__place_equity_order
tools.description: Place a real equity order with real money. Requires an agentic_allowed=true account. By default call review_equity_order first and get explicit user confirmation before calling this tool. Skip review only when the user has very explicitly asked to bypass it.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

quantity.description: Number of shares. Decimals (fractional) allowed for market + regular_hours only.

dollar_amount.description: USD notional (e.g. '100.00'). Only valid with type=market.

limit_price.description: Limit price; required for limit or stop_limit.

stop_price.description: Stop trigger price; required for stop_market or stop_limit.

ref_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Generate once per logical order and re-send on retry.

tax_lots.description: Optional specified-lot selection for a SELL order. At most 30 lots.

open_lot_id.description: open_lot_id of the open tax lot to sell, from get_equity_tax_lots.

quantity.description: Shares to sell from this lot as a decimal string.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__place_option_order
tools.description: Place a real options order with real money. Single-leg options orders only (Level 2 strategies). Requires agentic_allowed=true AND option_level_2 or option_level_3. By default call review_option_order first and get explicit user confirmation before calling this tool.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

ratio_quantity.description: Contracts for this leg per unit of the order's quantity. Defaults to 1.

price.description: Limit price per contract. Required for limit/stop_limit; must be omitted for market/stop_market.

stop_price.description: Stop trigger price per contract. Required for stop_limit/stop_market; must be omitted for limit/market.

ref_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Generate once per logical order and re-send on retry.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove items from a watchlist. Exactly one of symbols (stocks/ETFs), currency_pair_ids (crypto), or index_ids (market indexes) is required — mutually exclusive. For options use remove_option_from_watchlist. Items not on the list are no-ops. Confirm with the user before calling.

list_id.description: UUID of the watchlist to remove items from.

symbols.description: Stock symbols to remove. Mutually exclusive with currency_pair_ids and index_ids.

currency_pair_ids.description: Currency-pair UUIDs to remove. Mutually exclusive with symbols and index_ids.

index_ids.description: Index UUIDs to remove. Mutually exclusive with symbols and currency_pair_ids.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__remove_option_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove option contracts from the user's options watchlist. Specify the same position_type used when the contract was added (defaults to "long"). Contracts not on the list are no-ops. Confirm with the user before calling.

option_ids.description: Option contract UUIDs to remove. The position_type must match how each contract was added.

position_type.description: "long" (default) or "short". Must match how the contract was originally added.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__review_equity_order
tools.description: Simulate a stock order without placing it. Returns the current quote plus pre-trade alerts (buying power, PDT, instrument halt, etc.). Call this by default before place_equity_order unless the user has very explicitly asked to skip review. Requires an agentic_allowed=true account.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

quantity.description: Number of shares. Decimals (fractional) allowed for market + regular_hours only.

dollar_amount.description: USD notional (e.g. '100.00'). Only valid with type=market.

limit_price.description: Limit price; required for limit or stop_limit.

stop_price.description: Stop trigger price; required for stop_market or stop_limit.

time_in_force.description: 'gfd' (good for day) or 'gtc' (good till cancelled). Default: gfd.

tax_lots.description: Optional specified-lot selection for a SELL order. At most 30 lots.

open_lot_id.description: open_lot_id of the open tax lot to sell, from get_equity_tax_lots.

quantity.description: Shares to sell from this lot as a decimal string.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__review_option_order
tools.description: Simulate an options order without placing it. Returns the current quote plus pre-trade alerts. Call this by default before place_option_order unless the user has very explicitly asked to skip review. Single-leg options orders only (Level 2 strategies).

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must come from the user or be clearly implied — never default from get_accounts. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

ratio_quantity.description: Contracts for this leg per unit of the order's quantity. Defaults to 1.

price.description: Limit price per contract. Required for limit/stop_limit; must be omitted for market/stop_market.

stop_price.description: Stop trigger price per contract. Required for stop_limit/stop_market; must be omitted for limit/market.

chain_symbol.description: Underlying ticker (e.g. 'AAPL', 'SPXW'). Supply alongside underlying_type to include fees and collateral in the response.

underlying_type.description: 'equity' or 'index'. Required alongside chain_symbol to enable the fee + collateral fetch.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__run_scan
tools.description: Execute a saved scanner (screener) and return live market results. A scan's filters are evaluated against current market data at request time — results are real-time, not cached. Returns the scan's title, total matching instruments, instrument rows, plus the active sort and filters.

scan_id.description: The scan identifier to execute. Get this from get_scans or create_scan.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__search
tools.description: Resolve a natural-language query to Robinhood instruments (stocks/ETFs), crypto pairs, or market indexes. Use when the user names an asset by name (or partial name) instead of a ticker/pair/index symbol, or when you need an instrument_id / currency-pair UUID / market-index id for a downstream tool.

query.description: Natural-language search query: company name, partial name, or ticker (e.g. "apple", "tesla motors", "AAPL"). Required.

asset_type.description: Asset category to search. Supported: "instrument" (US-listed stocks/ETFs), "currency_pair" (crypto pairs like BTC-USD), and "market_index" (e.g. SPX, NDX, DJI). Defaults to "instrument" when omitted.

limit.description: Max results to return. Defaults to 10; clamped to 20.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__unfollow_watchlist
tools.description: Stop following a Robinhood-curated list. The list itself is unchanged — it just no longer appears in the user's watchlists. Confirm with the user before calling.

list_id.description: UUID of the Robinhood-curated list to unfollow.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__update_scan_config
tools.description: Change the sort order of a saved scan's results table. The scan's filters and columns are preserved; only the sort changes. Cortex-managed scans (cortex_managed: true in get_scans) are rejected.

scan_id.description: The scan to modify. Get this from get_scans or create_scan. Cortex-managed scans are rejected.

sorting_column.description: Display name of the column to sort by (e.g. "Volume", "% Change", "RSI"). Must match a column currently visible on the scan.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__update_scan_filters
tools.description: Replace the filters on an existing saved scan. REPLACE semantics — the complete filter set provided replaces whatever filters the scan had. To add a single filter, read the scan first then pass all existing filters plus the new one. Cortex-managed scans are rejected.

scan_id.description: The scan to modify. Get this from get_scans or create_scan. Cortex-managed scans are rejected.

filters.description: The complete set of filters the scan should have after the update. REPLACE semantics. Send [] to clear all filters.

plot.description: Plot / price-field input for filters that have one.

tools.name: mcp__robinhood-trading__update_watchlist
tools.description: Rename a custom watchlist or change its icon/description. Robinhood-curated lists cannot be renamed; the call will fail with 404. Provide at least one of display_name, icon_emoji, display_description.

list_id.description: UUID of the watchlist to update. Obtain from get_watchlists.
